A Letter from Our Atelier · Addis Ababa

Every dress that leaves our atelier begins on a wooden loom in the highlands. SHEBA was founded on a simple promise: that a Habesha woman in Toronto or Stockholm should wear the same handwoven tibeb, cut by the same hands, as her sister celebrating Meskel at home in Addis.

We work with more than forty weavers across the city — masters of the patterns their mothers taught them. Each kemis is woven in 100% Ethiopian cotton, finished with gold, green or burgundy tibeb, and sewn to your measurements. Nothing is mass-produced; nothing is rushed.

"A kemis is not a dress. It is the thread between home and everywhere else we live."

Whether it is your wedding, your graduation, Timket or a Sunday at church — when you wear SHEBA, you carry Addis Ababa with you. We are honored to sew it for you.

The Craft · Woven, Not Made

Four days on the loom.
A lifetime in the closet.

Every SHEBA kemis is woven by hand on traditional looms in Addis Ababa. The cotton is spun, dyed and woven locally; the tibeb borders are counted thread by thread — a four-day process for a single dress. Then we cut it to your measurements and finish every seam by hand.

How to Order
— Wherever You Are

From our atelier in Addis Ababa to your doorstep — simple, personal, and made to fit.

  1. Choose your kemis & send your measurements

    Step 01→

    Pick a silhouette, then send bust, waist, hip and height by form, WhatsApp or Instagram DM. Not sure? We guide you.

  2. We weave, cut & sew in Addis Ababa

    Step 02→

    Your dress is woven on the loom and finished by hand within 2–3 weeks. You'll receive photos before it ships.

  3. Doorstep delivery — worldwide

    Step 03→

    Tracked express shipping to 30+ countries. Free delivery on orders over $250 — and a small gift from the atelier in every box.

"When I opened the box in Toronto, it smelled like my mother's closet in Addis. Every stitch carries home with it."
